entries.name: Milton Esco

expected_cases.sentence: Released after two days without bail. Juvenile hearing February 5, 1964; subsequent good-behavior release. Exact January release day unverified.

updates.charges: Alleged violation of a juvenile court restriction on civil-rights activity
updates.sentence: Arrested outside the Canton Freedom House on February 28, 1964 and held in the county jail through a March 6 juvenile hearing, according to CORE field secretary Edward S. Hollander. His March 9 report says local staff believed Esco had been released but had not verified the hearing outcome. No exact release date or final sentence is established.

entries.rationale: Hollander March 9, 1964 field report, page 1, explicitly dates February 28 arrest and county-jail confinement through March 6 hearing. Original scan inspected. A separate case is necessary because this followed the January leaflet arrest and court restriction. Unconfirmed belief that he was out is not treated as a verified March 6 release.
